      "mechanism": "Each tissue emits two cheap scalar signals about its own patch: (a) pairwise agreement among its k sub-queries, and (b) leave-one-out variance of its own answers across re-phrasings. A small meta-tissue aggregates these into a per-region 'regime vote' — consensus if agreement is high AND variance low, union if both are low, distrust (fall back to the strongest single sense) if variance is high. The regime decision is itself made by a Jev choice question over the region's signals, not a hard-coded threshold. Regions choosing different regimes are stitched by the organ layer only where adjacent regimes agree.",
      "jev_role": "Jev answers the per-tissue self-report questions (typed noul/score on the tissue's own text answers) and the meta-choice over regime; no Jev sees pixels.",
      "hypothesis": "A Jev-decided per-region regime selector achieves fidelity >= max(consensus-only 0.354, union-only 0.328) + 0.03 on edge-glyph text, and >= 0.60 on brightness-only text; refuted if the selector is within 0.01 of the better fixed regime on both text types (i.e. regime choice adds nothing).",
      "builds_on": "E2 (+0.053 consensus over averaging) and E4 (+0.046 union over best sense); the provisional principle itself is the thing being tested as a mechanism.",
      "cost": "~5 Jev calls per region per frame (self-reports + meta-choice), ~40 regions, one afternoon of inference on existing tissues.",
      "beyond_classic_ml": "Classic stacking learns one global aggregation rule; here the aggregation regime is itself a per-region, Jev-typed decision with no central editor, so the model can be in 'consensus mode' and 'union mode' at once in different parts of the same frame."
    },
    {
      "name": "Self-Pruning Tissue Lineage (what-dies-here)",
      "levels": ["cell", "tissue", "organ", "family"],
      "mechanism": "Exploit the measured asymmetry: tissue background-what is 0.87-1.0 but object-what is 0.03-0.24. Give every tissue a descendant budget (say 1-3 children) and let a Jev score decide whether the tissue's 'what' claim is worth propagating or whether the tissue should instead specialise into a pure background/edge/motion sensor. Tissues that fail the object-what Jev question lose their 'what' organ and re-differentiate into a raw numeric receptor (the E4 weak sense). The lineage tree is recorded so a family-level view can see which lineages survived; survivors get more descendants next frame.",
      "jev_role": "Jev asks each tissue a score question: 'does this text label plausibly name a distinct object present at these coordinates?' Tissues below tau lose their label organ and re-role.",
      "hypothesis": "Removing object-what claims from low-confidence tissues raises overall fidelity by >= 0.04 over the E1 baseline (0.24-0.31 on edge-glyph text) and background accuracy stays >= 0.85; refuted if fidelity gain is < 0.01 or background accuracy drops below 0.80.",
      "builds_on": "E1's measured asymmetry (background 0.87-1.0 vs object 0.03-0.24) and the neighbour-gossip failure (0.87 -> 0.63 background when labels spread).",
      "cost": "One extra Jev score per tissue per frame (~24 tissues) plus a lineage bookkeeper; ~30 min of inference.",
      "beyond_classic_ml": "The network prunes its own representational capacity per region based on a typed verdict about semantic content, and re-differentiates into a weaker but honest sensor — a structural response to measured incompetence rather than a weight update."
    },
    {
      "name": "Holarchic Research Loop: Tissues That Propose Their Own Experiments",
      "levels": ["tissue", "organ", "organism", "community"],
      "mechanism": "Wrap the existing first-round ideas into a meta-organism: a 'research tissue' reads the last round's measured CIs and, via Jev, proposes one variant of an existing idea (a mutation of a projector config, a new Jev rubric, a new tissue role) with an explicit refutation number. The community runs the top-3 variants in parallel this week; the meta-tissue that proposed the winning variant gets its descendant budget increased next round, the losers are archived. No central editor: multiple meta-tissues can coexist and the survivor is decided by measured CIs, not by vote.",
      "jev_role": "Jev reads the measured-results JSON and writes typed proposals (name, mechanism, hypothesis, refutation number) as structured JSON; Jev also writes the per-variant Jev rubrics used inside each experiment.",
      "hypothesis": "Across 3 generations, the best community-proposed variant improves the community's headline fidelity (edge-glyph text) by >= 0.05 over the best first-round idea (0.354 consensus); refuted if after 3 generations the best variant is within 0.02 of 0.354, i.e. self-proposed experiments do not compound.",
      "builds_on": "The full measured table, especially E2's +0.053 consensus headroom and E4's +0.046 union, plus the observed gossip failure (beliefs spread errors, choices coordinate) which motivates 'propose experiments, don't propagate beliefs'.",
      "cost": "3 Jev meta-proposals per generation x 3 generations = ~9 Jev calls, plus running 3 top variants per generation (each already costed in round 1).",
      "beyond_classic_ml": "The research loop itself becomes a holarchy: tissues propose experiments, organs run them, the family selects by measured CIs, and the community has no editor — selection pressure acts on the ability to propose falsifiable experiments, not just on model weights."
    }
  ]
}

Fidelity vs truth: 0.30 on brightness-only text (a VLM reading the same text: 0.28), about 60% of the VLM on edge-glyph text (VLM 0.49-0.51 vs swarm 0.24-0.31). Tissues recognise background well (0.87-1.0) but what object they hold poorly (0.03-0.24): information dies at tissue-level 'what', not at organ assembly. Motion arrows survive (motion recall 0.40). Letting tissues hear neighbours' claims spread object labels into empty sky: background accuracy 0.87 -> 0.63, net fidelity down (not significant).
E2 community jury: three VLM critics reconstruct the same text. Believing the reconstruction the other two agree with most (no judge, no centre) beats averaging them: 0.354 vs 0.301 (+0.053, CI [0.016, 0.089]); a Jev judge choosing among them +0.042 (CI [0.006, 0.078]); oracle 0.433.
E3 guided growth: 8x4 tissues sense their patch of the real frame as numbers and choose how to draw themselves (tone / edges / braille / motion arrows); a second round hearing neighbours' CHOICES helps (+0.066, CI [0.002, 0.128]) but the mosaic only ties drawing everything with edges (0.328 vs 0.350, n.s.): mixing styles creates seams. Jev almost never chose the motion style (6 of 320 tissues).
E4 kaleidoscope: each tissue has two independent weak senses (raw text, numeric receptors). Asserting an object only where both agree collapses fidelity to 0.10 (they rarely agree); their UNION beats the better sense (+0.046, CI [0.019, 0.076]) and ties an oracle that knows which sense to trust.
PRINCIPLE (provisional): consensus helps when members are individually competent and errors are noise; union helps when members are weak and err in different places; gossiping BELIEFS spreads errors, gossiping CHOICES coordinates.
